title: Otter waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- water line -->
  <rect x='0' y='78' width='100' height='22' fill='#2f9fe0'/>
  <path d='M0 78 Q10 74 20 78 Q30 82 40 78 Q50 74 60 78 Q70 82 80 78 Q90 74 100 78 L100 82 Q90 78 80 82 Q70 86 60 82 Q50 78 40 82 Q30 86 20 82 Q10 78 0 82 Z' fill='#1b6fb4'/>

  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='20' ry='16' fill='#b06a2c'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='14' ry='11' fill='#e0a85a'/>

  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='16' ry='14' fill='#b06a2c'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='11' ry='8' fill='#e0a85a'/>

  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='32' r='4.5' fill='#b06a2c'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='32' r='4.5' fill='#b06a2c'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='32' r='2.5' fill='#e0a85a'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='32' r='2.5' fill='#e0a85a'/>

  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='40' r='2.6' fill='#2b1a10'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='40' r='2.6' fill='#2b1a10'/>
  <circle cx='44.8' cy='39.2' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='56.8' cy='39.2' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='2.8' ry='2' fill='#4a2a12'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M46 49 Q50 52 54 49' fill='none' stroke='#4a2a12' stroke-width='1.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- whiskers -->
  <line x1='36' y1='45' x2='28' y2='43' stroke='#e0a85a' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='36' y1='47' x2='28' y2='48' stroke='#e0a85a' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='64' y1='45' x2='72' y2='43' stroke='#e0a85a' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='64' y1='47' x2='72' y2='48' stroke='#e0a85a' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- left arm (down) -->
  <path d='M32 62 Q26 70 28 76' fill='none' stroke='#b06a2c' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- right arm waving -->
  <path d='M68 60 Q76 52 78 40' fill='none' stroke='#b06a2c' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M76 42 Q80 36 78 30' fill='none' stroke='#b06a2c' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- wave motion lines -->
  <path d='M82 28 Q85 26 88 28' fill='none' stroke='#ffd24a' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M83 33 Q87 32 90 34' fill='none' stroke='#ffd24a' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M81 23 Q83 20 86 21' fill='none' stroke='#ffd24a' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- little water bubbles -->
  <circle cx='20' cy='80' r='2' fill='#8fd4ff'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='83' r='1.4' fill='#b8e4ff'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='82' r='1.8' fill='#8fd4ff'/>
</svg>
